fields.purpose: Utvikling, salg, engros, produksjon og logistikk av petrokjemi og bio produkter. explanation.summary: RE-DUCE AS (997 076 982), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2011-06-03; address Fagerstrandbakken, 1454 FAGERSTRAND, Norge. Main industry is 71.129 Annen teknisk konsulentvirksomhet; 7 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Arne Karlsen; Board chair: Arne Karlsen; Auditor: UNIC REVISJON AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 28.56 m, operating profit NOK -755.05 k, net profit NOK -676.48 k, equity NOK 217.14 k, total assets NOK 5.04 m. Website https://www.re-duce.no shows the registered name.
